subject: social_studies
concept: Applying government types, scale of governance, social institutions, rules/laws, and structural comparison to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student designs a simple governance structure for an imagined small community, including rules and roles
exercise.abstract: Student explains their designed structure's reasoning

assessment.mastery_threshold: design reflects a coherent governance structure with clear roles and at least one rule
misconception_flags: design has no actual structure or roles, just a vague description with no organization

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
